result.finding: The application has two external system dependencies: (1) Azure Service Bus — the cloud message broker to which messages are published via AMQP 1.0; (2) Azure Managed Identity — used for passwordless authentication to Azure Service Bus, eliminating the need for stored credentials. No databases, caches, file shares, LDAP, or other external systems are required.
evidence: application.properties: spring.cloud.azure.servicebus.namespace= (Azure Service Bus namespace, set at runtime)
No datasource, jdbc, redis, ldap, S3, or blob storage configuration found
README.md notes this is a demo of sending messages to a message broker (originally RabbitMQ, now Azure Service Bus)
values: Azure Service Bus (cloud message queue, AMQP 1.0) — required
